newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha falls after crude, gasoline selloff.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha falls after crude, gasoline selloff.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices fell on Friday after the late Thursday selloff in crude and gasoline futures, and traders waited for further direction from the NYMEX open.
Nov swaps traded at $216 and $216.25 and were still quoted later at $216.50, down $4 from yesterday.
Cargoes also fell, dropping about $2 to $219/$221 cif NWE.
Traders said naphtha was whipsawed by crude's volatile action but that end user demand still did not look like it would be robust until mid-month.
